lawyer:
Bivash Chandra Biswas, Advocate-on-Record ------ For the Petitioner 
A. B. M. Nurul Islam, Senior Advocate, instructed by Mr. Syed Mahbubur Rahman, Advocate-on-Record ------ For Respondent Nos.1 (a)-1(e). 
Respondent Nos,2-14 ------ Not represented
parties:
Haji Shafiqur Rahman ------ Petitioner
Vs.
Abdul Malek Chowdhury and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 7. Mr. Bivash Chandra Biswas, learned Advocate-on-Record, appearing on behalf of the leave petitioner, submits that defendant No. 1 could not prove that his deed of sale dated 14.11.1961 was genuine and that it was executed and registered by proforma defendant No. 13, Mohammad Mia Chowdhury and that the High Court Division without taking into consideration the question of burden of proof concurred with the findings and decision of the trial Court. He further submits that the High Court Division being the final Court of fact came to a wrong finding that defendant No. 1 has been in possession of the suit land by misreading and non-reading of the evidence on record and that the plaintiff could not prove his possession in the suit land.
